title: SPIFFE SVID Structure
description: JSON Structure document describing the SPIFFE Verifiable Identity Document (SVID) data model for both X.509-SVIDs and JWT-SVIDs.

types.name: X509SVID
types.description: X.509 SVID — a SPIFFE identity encoded as an X.509 certificate

fields.name: bundle
fields.description: DER-encoded trust bundle for the trust domain (base64)

fields.name: hint
fields.description: Optional workload hint for SVID selection

types.name: JWTSVID
types.description: JWT-SVID — a SPIFFE identity encoded as a signed JSON Web Token

fields.name: spiffe_id
fields.description: SPIFFE URI from the token subject claim

types.name: TrustBundle
types.description: SPIFFE trust bundle encoded as a JWKS document for trust domain validation

fields.name: keys
fields.description: Array of JWK entries representing root CA certificates

types.name: JWK
types.description: A JSON Web Key entry in a SPIFFE trust bundle
